overview.title: Configurator & calculation
overview.subline: Set up how films, boards and other articles are calculated: calculations with their own formula, materials with prices per m² and options with surcharges.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: All areas of Mensura at a glance.

calculation.title: Calculations
calculation.description: Calculation templates per article type: format limits, base price per piece, minimum price, price tiers and formula.

material.title: Materials
material.description: Boards and films with price per m², tiers, raw formats and properties.

option.title: Options
option.description: Option groups such as colours, cutting or finishing with values and surcharges (€/m², €/pc, %, flat).

price.helpPurchase: Net purchase price, e.g. €26.00 per m² according to the Comdatek price list. Only visible with the permission “Purchase prices”.
price.helpSale: Net sale price for resellers, e.g. €29.00 per m². Other customer groups get their surcharge on top.

components.hint: Several components are added up, e.g. contour cut = €3.00/m² + €0.50/pc. Discounts with minus, e.g. −€8.00/m² for unprinted.

types.factor: factor on the rate per m²
types.base_area: replaces the material price per m²

tiers.helpBasis: What the tier is measured on, e.g. “Total area”: 5 banners of 3 m² = 15 m² → tier “from 10 m²”.
tiers.warnOrder: Tier jump: thresholds not ascending or a higher tier is more expensive – please check.

supplierCodes.title: Supplier codes
supplierCodes.help: Mensura builds the supplier's article number from these, e.g. Comdatek “29.1” for aluminium composite 3 mm.

info.title: What is a material?
info.text: A material is the carrier that is printed on – e.g. aluminium composite 3 mm or film A. It has a price per m² (purchase and sale), optionally a minimum price, minimum area and tiers. The follow-up set controls which options the customer sees next. The calculation the material is assigned to does the maths.

list.emptySubline: Add the first material, e.g. “Aluminium composite 3 mm” at €29.00 per m².
list.confirmDelete: Really delete material “{name}”? Prices per material in calculations are deleted as well.
list.deleteRestricted: Cannot delete: the material is still used in a product profile. Remove it there first or deactivate the material.

detail.helpName: How the customer sees the material, e.g. “Aluminium composite 3 mm”.
detail.helpTechnicalName: Unique key without spaces, e.g. “alu-3mm”. Used in links and interfaces – avoid changing it later.
detail.helpCode: Short code for the article number, e.g. “ALU3” → ALU3-1000x500.
detail.helpDescription: One or two sentences for the material tile, e.g. “The classic for signs indoors and outdoors.”
detail.helpBadges: Short features on the tile, e.g. “outdoor”, “Bestseller”. Confirm each with Enter.
detail.placeholderBadges: Type a badge and press Enter …
detail.helpActive: Inactive materials do not appear in the configurator but remain in old orders.
detail.helpCalculations: The calculation the material is calculated in, e.g. “Aluminium composite”. Option prices and format limits come from there.
detail.helpOptionSet: Which option groups appear after choosing this material, e.g. “Board finishing aluminium composite” with colours, finishing, drilling and cutting.
detail.introPrice: The suggested sale price follows the sale rule ({rule}). What is in the sale field is always saved.
detail.helpPricePurchase: Purchase price per m², e.g. €26.00 (Comdatek purchase price aluminium composite 3 mm).
detail.helpPriceSale: Sale price per m² for resellers, e.g. €29.00.
detail.helpMinimumPrice: An item never costs less, e.g. €12.50 for aluminium composite, even for a small sign. Empty = minimum price of the calculation.
detail.helpMinArea: Smaller areas are charged as this area, e.g. film A from 1 m²: 0.5 m² costs the same as 1 m². Empty = value of the calculation.
detail.helpAreaRounding: The area is rounded up to these steps, e.g. 0.1: 1.23 m² is charged as 1.30 m². Empty = value of the calculation.
detail.cardComponents: Further price components of the material
detail.introComponents: Added to the base prices of the calculation, e.g. mesh banner €0.20 per piece.
detail.introTiers: A tier replaces the price per m² from a threshold or gives a discount. Purchase and sale can use different bases, e.g. sale by total area, purchase by area per piece.
detail.helpWidthMax: Only needed if the material is narrower than the calculation allows, e.g. roll width 1,370 mm.
detail.helpHeightMax: Only needed if the material is shorter than the calculation allows, e.g. board length 2,000 mm.
detail.helpSheet: Size of the raw board or roll, e.g. 1,500 × 3,050 mm – for later nesting/waste calculation.
detail.helpWeight: For shipping and packaging, e.g. 3.8 kg for aluminium composite 3 mm. Mensura calculates the weight of every item from it.
detail.introSupplier: Optional suggestion who produces the material. The suggestion on the material wins over the calculation.
detail.helpSupplier: Supplier from LieferLotse, e.g. Comdatek. Order distribution decides later.

warnings.noPrice: The material has no sale price per m² yet – the shop cannot show a price for it.
warnings.saleBelowPurchase: The sale price is not above the purchase price – please check the prices.
warnings.noCalculation: The material is not assigned to any calculation and cannot be sold this way.
